# Python environments used for the revision

## 1. Rendering environment (DOCX / PDF; no statistics)

CPython 3.12.13

    python-docx==1.2.0
    pypdf==6.20.1

Used by `revision_2026/code/build_tables/build_tables_docx.py` and
`revision_2026/code/build_tables/build_supplement_pdf.py`.

## 2. Neoantigen environment

CPython 3.12.13 (the isolated environment `neoantigen/env`)

    mhcflurry==2.3.14         # model weights bundled offline under models/2.3.0
    torch==2.14.1+cpu
    statsmodels==0.15.0       # added for the stage-3 statistics
    pandas / numpy            # as required by mhcflurry

Used by `revision_2026/code/neoantigen/01_build_peptides.py` … `10_cond_logit_fix.py`.

No Python package performs any of the statistics reported in the manuscript; those are computed in R.
